0022600163.text: The 76ers, who are 6-1 and first in the Atlantic and the East, host the 1-5 Bulls, who are 13th in the East and have lost four straight, while Philadelphia is on a three-game winning streak and is 3-1 at home. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Joel Embiid (foot) and LeBron James (back), and Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), while Dailyn Swain is day-to-day with back soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the 76ers lost their 2025-26 series 1-2 before beating Chicago 157-137 in Philadelphia on March 25, 2026.
